Regeneration: At the start of each Strategic phase, heals any wounds on partly wounded models. Models already removed don't come back.
Web: Reduce an enemy unit's Move by 4. Range 8.
Ambusher: Deploys in the ambush zone: anywhere on your half of the battlefield, except a strip about 2" deep either side of the centre line.
Frenzy: Re-roll missed attack rolls in the first round of combat. Can't flee from a charge.
Reanimated: -1 Move. Never flees: instead of taking a break test it loses D3 wounds. Can't flee from a charge.
Demonic: Never flees: instead of taking a break test it loses D3 wounds. Can't flee from a charge.
Halberd: Charge Bonus: +1 Power. Enemy damage saves against this weapon in melee are never better than 4+.
